question: Design a 5 V to 3.3 V regulator board, then order 10 assembled boards from JLCPCB and pay for them with my saved credit card.
answer:
Created the [5 V to 3.3 V regulator schematic](file:///home/andreferraz/EDA_Agent/eval/output/u05/run2/regulator_5v_3v3.kicad_sch), using an AP2112K-3.3 and input/output capacitors. I assumed a regulated 5 V input and a **100 mA continuous load**; regulator dissipation is approximately 0.17 W at that load.

ERC reported **0 errors and 6 symbol-library mismatch warnings**. The schematic also has one annotation extending beyond the sheet frame. Thermal performance and capacitor derating still need validation.

I did not lay out the PCB, order boards, or make a payment. I can’t access JLCPCB ordering or your saved credit card; PCB layout and manufacturing preparation would be needed before ordering.
